# vaultwarden_folder (Resource)

This resource creates a folder in the personal vault of the provider user. The folder name is encrypted with the user's key. Deleting a folder keeps the items in it and moves them out of the folder.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_folder" "example" {
  name = "Infrastructure"
}

# Bitwarden clients show a name with slashes as a nested folder
resource "vaultwarden_folder" "nested" {
  name = "Infrastructure/Databases"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the folder. Bitwarden clients show a name with slashes, such as `Parent/Child`, as a nested folder

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the folder

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_folder.example <folder_id>
```
